status: Exploratory source/build evidence, not release acceptance
method: Temporary modfile/sum and Go source overlay: replace module/import path and raise go directive to1.26.6; then replace removed contexts with agent.Context and pass t.Context() to two NewEvent calls. Production checkout was not modified.

runs.outcome: Compile failed on removed ToolContext/CallbackContext family and two missing NewEvent context arguments; compiler output reported ToolContext first and truncated later errors.

runs.limitations: Package outcomes recorded; individual case/skip counts were not captured. PostgreSQL cases were not exercised.

runs.phase: Full production Go package build under candidate dependency graph

environment_attempts: Initial dependency download failed under sandbox DNS; initial HTTP tests failed sandbox port binding. Successful reruns allowed public dependency fetch/local httptest listeners. These setup failures are not ADK incompatibilities.

confirmed_api_changes.change: ToolContext and CallbackContext become agent.Context; custom hidden Run/ProcessRequest interfaces must be migrated too

semantic_review.finding: Orphan function responses/unanswered calls are filtered from model projection; raw session events are retained. Normal complete single-tool cycles showed no demonstrated break.
Functiontool result/schema JSON normalization changed; current Planner suites passed after mechanical adaptation. Extra raw-type/history matrices remain required.

Root workflow wrapper changes goroutine/persistence handshake and cancellation lifecycle; current root keeps chat behavior and nil retry config. Extra automatic retries/durable control events were not established.
LLMResponse JSON tags change, but Contractor writes its own allowlisted reduced facts rather than raw ADK responses.

compaction_conflicts.finding: LLMSummarizer calls model.GenerateContent directly, outside current Planner callback accounting and custom telemetry.
Native tail retention suppresses AppendEvent failure and continues, conflicting with PLN-R106. Failure must fence next calls and candidate completion, including post-finish paths.
Native compaction retains raw history; sliding summaries do not bound prompt growth. Explicit aggregate memory/work and rolling-context bounds are required.
Typed plan lacks historical validated Worker results; State tools expose only newest completion. Exact refs and completed effects need a separate bounded authoritative retrieval path.
Terminal summarizer currently belongs to Worker, not Planner. Mutual exclusion is local to a context owner; Planner compact cannot globally prohibit an independent Worker terminal policy.

Current custom Gateway rejects length but drops other raw finish reasons; compactor success admission needs explicit metadata and real HTTP tests. Its selected model context window may be smaller than the main model window.

reproduction: Re-establish exact tagged/module checksums and current consumers in V419-001. Temporary paths and this chat are not required inputs. Final acceptance uses committed modules without overlays.
